properties.title: Memory Initialized Before Write
properties.description: Memory must be initialized as a bytearray before any write operation can be executed
properties.formal_spec: FORALL write IN memory_write_ops: memory.initialized == true BEFORE execute_write(write)

properties.title: Memory Modified After Write
properties.description: After a write operation completes, memory must contain the written data at the specified range
properties.formal_spec: FORALL write IN memory_write_ops: execute_write(write) IMPLIES memory[write.offset:write.offset+len(write.data)] == write.data

properties.title: Buffer Read Returns Correct Length
properties.description: Buffer reads with zero-padding must always return exactly the requested size in bytes
properties.formal_spec: FORALL read IN buffer_reads: len(buffer_read(read.offset, read.size)) == read.size

properties.title: Zero Padding Applied for Out-of-Bounds Reads
properties.description: When reading past memory bounds, the out-of-bounds portion must be zero-padded
properties.formal_spec: FORALL read IN buffer_reads WHERE read.offset + read.size > memory.size: result[memory.size - read.offset:] == bytes(0) * (read.offset + read.size - memory.size)

properties.title: Expansion Cost Calculated Before Expansion
properties.description: Gas cost for memory expansion must be calculated before expanding memory
properties.formal_spec: FORALL expansion IN memory_expansions: calculate_cost(expansion) EXECUTES BEFORE expand_memory(expansion)

properties.title: Expanded Memory Initialized to Zero
properties.description: Any new memory region created by expansion must be initialized to zero bytes
properties.formal_spec: FORALL expansion IN memory_expansions: memory[old_size:new_size] == bytes(0) * (new_size - old_size) AFTER expand_memory(expansion)

properties.title: Memory Size Rounded to 32-Byte Words
properties.description: After expansion, memory size must be aligned to 32-byte word boundaries
properties.formal_spec: FORALL expansion IN memory_expansions: memory.size % 32 == 0 AFTER expand_memory(expansion)

properties.title: Magic Bytes Check Before EOF Processing
properties.description: Before processing code as EOF, the magic bytes 0xEF00 must be verified
properties.formal_spec: FORALL deploy IN contract_deployments: process_as_eof(deploy.bytecode) REQUIRES deploy.bytecode[0:2] == 0xEF00

properties.title: Version 0x00 Always Rejected
properties.description: EOF containers with version byte 0x00 must always fail validation
properties.formal_spec: FORALL deploy IN eof_deployments: deploy.bytecode[2] == 0x00 IMPLIES deploy.result == REJECTED

properties.title: Container Size Limit Enforced
properties.description: No EOF container can exceed MAX_INITCODE_SIZE (49152 bytes)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL container IN valid_eof_containers: len(container) <= 49152

properties.title: No Stray Bytes in Valid Containers
properties.description: Valid EOF containers must have no bytes outside declared sections
properties.formal_spec: FORALL container IN valid_eof_containers: sum(section_sizes) + header_size == len(container)

properties.title: Code Format Detection Before Execution Mode
properties.description: The code format must be detected before selecting execution mode
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN contract_calls: detect_code_format(call.code) EXECUTES BEFORE set_execution_mode(call)

properties.title: EOF Execution Starts at Code Section 0
properties.description: EOF contract execution must begin at the first byte of code section 0
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN eof_contract_calls: call.initial_pc == code_section_0_offset(call.code)

properties.title: Rejected Opcodes Never Execute in EOF
properties.description: Opcodes in the EOF reject list must never execute in EOF context
properties.formal_spec: FORALL op IN eof_opcode_executions: op.opcode NOT IN eof_reject_list

properties.title: DELEGATECALL to Legacy Fails
properties.description: DELEGATECALL from EOF contract to non-EOF contract must fail
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN eof_delegatecalls: NOT is_eof(call.target) IMPLIES call.result == FAILED

properties.title: EXTCODESIZE Returns 2 for EOF
properties.description: EXTCODESIZE called on an EOF contract always returns 2
properties.formal_spec: FORALL query IN extcodesize_calls WHERE is_eof(query.target): query.result == 2

properties.title: EXTCODECOPY Returns Only Magic Bytes
properties.description: EXTCODECOPY on EOF contract returns only bytes from 0xEF00
properties.formal_spec: FORALL copy IN extcodecopy_eof_calls: copy.result == 0xEF00[copy.offset:min(copy.offset+copy.length, 2)]

properties.title: EXTCODEHASH Returns Fixed Hash for EOF
properties.description: EXTCODEHASH on EOF contract always returns keccak256(0xEF00)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL hash IN extcodehash_eof_calls: hash.result == keccak256(0xEF00)

properties.title: Deployed EOF Code Immutable
properties.description: Once validated and deployed, EOF container code cannot be modified
properties.formal_spec: FORALL t1, t2 IN timeline WHERE t1 < t2: deployed_code(address, t1) == deployed_code(address, t2)

properties.title: Deposit Event Emitted Before Tree Inclusion
properties.description: A deposit event must be emitted by the contract before the deposit can be added to the Merkle tree
properties.formal_spec: FORALL deposit IN merkle_tree_deposits: emit_deposit_event(deposit) EXECUTES BEFORE add_to_tree(deposit)

properties.title: Finalization Requires Both Conditions
properties.description: A deposit is finalized only when both eth1_data and deposit_index conditions are met
properties.formal_spec: FORALL deposit IN finalized_deposits: eth1_data_finalized(deposit) AND deposit_index_condition_met(deposit)

properties.title: Merkle Proof Required for Unfinalized Deposits
properties.description: Unfinalized deposits require Merkle proofs for beacon chain inclusion
properties.formal_spec: FORALL inclusion IN beacon_deposit_inclusions WHERE NOT finalized(inclusion.deposit): inclusion.has_merkle_proof == true

properties.title: Snapshot Validation Before Tree Reconstruction
properties.description: Snapshot must be validated before reconstructing the deposit tree
properties.formal_spec: FORALL sync IN snapshot_syncs: validate_snapshot(sync.snapshot) == true BEFORE reconstruct_tree(sync.snapshot)

properties.title: Root Mismatch Rejects Snapshot
properties.description: If calculated root does not match transmitted root, snapshot must be rejected
properties.formal_spec: FORALL validation IN snapshot_validations: calculate_root(validation.hashes) != validation.transmitted_root IMPLIES snapshot_rejected(validation)

properties.title: Reconstructed Tree Supports New Deposits
properties.description: After reconstruction, the tree must be capable of accepting new deposits
properties.formal_spec: FORALL tree IN reconstructed_trees: can_append_deposit(tree) == true

properties.title: Eth1 Data Finalization Checked First
properties.description: The eth1_data finalization condition must be checked before the deposit_index condition
properties.formal_spec: FORALL finalization IN deposit_finalizations: check_eth1_data_finalized(finalization) EXECUTES BEFORE check_deposit_index(finalization)

properties.title: Pruning Only After Both Conditions Met
properties.description: Tree nodes can only be pruned after both finalization conditions are satisfied
properties.formal_spec: FORALL prune IN tree_prunes: eth1_data_finalized(prune.node) AND deposit_index_met(prune.node)

properties.title: Pruning Preserves Proof Generation
properties.description: After pruning, the tree must still be able to generate valid Merkle proofs for non-finalized deposits
properties.formal_spec: FORALL tree IN pruned_trees, deposit IN tree.unfinalized_deposits: can_generate_proof(tree, deposit) == true

properties.title: Snapshot Response Contains Required Fields
properties.description: API response must contain finalized hashes, deposit root, count, and execution block hash
properties.formal_spec: FORALL response IN snapshot_responses: response.finalized_hashes != null AND response.deposit_root != null AND response.deposit_count != null AND response.execution_block_hash != null

properties.title: Quadratic Gas Cost Limits Memory Growth
properties.description: Memory expansion gas cost follows quadratic formula preventing unbounded growth
properties.formal_spec: FORALL expansion IN memory_expansions: expansion.gas_cost == (words^2)/512 + 3*words WHERE words = ceil(expansion.new_size/32)

properties.title: Section Order Validated Before Type Size
properties.description: Section ordering must be validated before validating individual section sizes
properties.formal_spec: FORALL validation IN eof_validations: validate_section_order(validation) EXECUTES BEFORE validate_type_size(validation)

properties.title: Deposit Ordering Preserved in Tree
properties.description: Deposits must maintain their submission order when added to the Merkle tree
properties.formal_spec: FORALL d1, d2 IN deposits WHERE d1.index < d2.index: tree_position(d1) < tree_position(d2)
